question: Which anti-Covid scheme was launched by the Haryana government on 24 March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjeevani Project**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Haryana government launched the **Sanjeevani Project** on 24 March 2021.
 
• This project is an anti-Covid scheme aimed at combating the spread of Covid-19 and providing necessary healthcare support.
 
• The project includes various measures such as vaccination drives, public awareness campaigns, and the provision of medical facilities.
